# Requirements Artifacts

Requirements engineering documents generated by the `software-engineer` agent via the `/define-product` and `/gather-requirements` prompts.

## Expected Artifacts

| File                     | Description                                       | Prompt                 |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| `product-vision.md`      | Product Vision Document                           | `/define-product`      |
| `personas.md`            | Target audience personas                          | `/define-product`      |
| `prd.md`                 | Product Requirements Document                     | `/define-product`      |
| `user-stories.md`        | User Stories                                      | `/gather-requirements` |
| `srs.md`                 | Software Requirements Specification (IEEE 830)    | `/gather-requirements` |
| `traceability-matrix.md` | Requirements × Issues × Tests traceability matrix | `/gather-requirements` |
